Pathetic. No cleanliness, poor old unclean torn linens and beds. The linen isnt changed after the previous guests checkout, it is just re arranged. The rooms reek of dirty smell, im unsure whether its  due to smoking/alcohol but its just masked with some cheap room freshener.

FULL OF COCKROACHES.

Worst hotel ever. Stayed here for 2 days and it was a horrible experience. Rooms were dirty, bathroom hand shower was broken, and there was a bad smell in the room. Cockroaches were present which is completely unacceptable. No proper facilities or basic maintenance. Totally unhygienic and not worth the money. Do not recommend at all.

Absolutely Appalling – A Nightmare Stay You Should Avoid at All Costs
This has been, without a doubt, the worst hotel experience we’ve had in decades, and that's saying a lot. From the moment we checked in, it was a disaster in every sense.
• The beds were infested with cockroaches, crawling through torn mattresses with stuffing spilling out — it felt like staying in a pest-ridden storage unit rather than a hotel room.
• The air conditioning was completely non-functional, leaving the room humid, suffocating, and impossible to rest in — especially for a family traveling with children.
• There was no hot water in the bathrooms, making even basic hygiene a struggle.
• To make matters worse, there is no restaurant on-site, and the hotel offers no proper food service despite being advertised as a full-service facility.
• The staff was extremely unprofessional, rude, and combative — rather than addressing our concerns, they responded with arguments and complete indifference.
• We had paid extra for a “breakfast included” option, only to be told we’re allowed a single cold sandwich while everything else is chargeable — an absolute scam and false advertising.
• TV switches didn’t work, most amenities were broken or in disrepair, and the room itself was in shambles.
This wasn’t just disappointing — it was borderline uninhabitable and a health hazard. I would never recommend this property to anyone. It was humiliating and distressing to subject my family to such conditions on what was supposed to be a relaxing trip.
Avoid this place at all costs — the management is careless, the facilities are deteriorated beyond repair, and it’s an outright disgrace to the hospitality industry.
